source: cogs: searched 3 rates (0.5x, 1x, 2x the published one) on `baseline` alone. the published rate reaches the published range (99.70), so it stands. Confirmed, not replaced. Every architecture in the grid is trained on this recipe unchanged; none of them had a vote in it. Published starting point: Csordas et al. 2021 (arXiv 2108.12284): a constant 1e-4, 50,000 steps, no early stopping, no label smoothing. Reaches 81 percent on the generalization split against 35 for the original recipe, with a spread across seeds of +/- 0.00.
